messages:
Maya P.: Draft PRD for Dedicated Capacity v2 — focusing on SLA targets, throughput sizing model, autoscale behavior, and acceptance criteria. I sketched a proposal; need engineering + SRE review. Goal: ship an MVP baseline for Q2 launch. Please review edge cases (burst, warm pools, evictions) by EOD Fri.

Ajay R.: Shared the doc link: https://redwood.internal/docs/dedicated-capacity/prd-v2 (skeleton). Quick notes: we should define both steady-state throughput and short-burst guarantees. Also list out telemetry events we'll need.

Sara L.: For sizing, can we use a percentile-based ticket: baseline p95 latency per model class and compute tokens/sec capacity per GPU type? I'll add a spreadsheet.

Kevin H.: Agree. Also need autoscale ramp-up/down cooldowns and max scale rate. Suggest:
```
- min_pool = 2 nodes
- max_pool = based on reserved commit
- scale_up_cooldown = 30s
- scale_down_cooldown = 5m
```
Add warm-pool prefetch: keep KV-cache warm for top 10% of routes.

Maya P.: Good. For SLAs I propose:
```
- Availability >= 99.95% (monthly)
- p95 <= 200ms for 'low-latency' tier
- p99 <= 1.5s for 'best-effort' tier
- Throughput guarantee: X tokens/sec per reserved GPU (we'll fill numbers after spreadsheet)
```
Thoughts on enforcement: auto-fallback to hosted model variant when capacity constrained, with alerting and customer-visible incidents.

Ajay R.: Enforcement ok. We need acceptance tests: canary with synthetic load, chaos tests (node drain), and a throttle-respect test that verifies fallback within 2 minutes of overload.

Sara L.: Edge cases to call out in PRD:
- cold start amplification when cache miss rate > 70%
- simultaneous regional outage — how cross-region fallback behaves
- commit size changes mid-month (customer increases reserved GPUs)
- model rollouts with incompatible KV cache formats

Kevin H.: Also add cost protection rules: don't autoscale above customer commit without explicit opt-in. And define behavior during capacity preemption.

deploy-bot: Deploy preview created for prd-dedicated-capacity-v2 (env=staging) — https://staging.redwood/deploys/3521 :robot_face:

Maya P.: Action items:
- @Ajay R. add telemetry events and alert runbook
- @Sara L. fill sizing spreadsheet and quant numbers
- @Kevin H. write scale policy RFC and prefilling algorithm
- I'll consolidate and draft acceptance criteria section (canary checks, metrics thresholds)

Ajay R.: Can we aim to freeze the PRD text by Tue so eng can start spike work Wed?

Maya P.: Yes — target freeze Tue COB. If blockers, flag in this thread. :thumbsup:

Kevin H.: Quick question: for warm-pool prefill, do we keep KV cache process pinned to GPUs or rebuild on node add? That impacts warmup latency.

Sara L.: We should prefer pinned cache for hot routes, but fallback to rebuild for infrequent ones. I'll add a short decision matrix.

Maya P.: Cool — thanks everyone. I'll update doc w/ these points and ping again when the acceptance criteria section is baked. :sparkles:
